samples.summary: Share-link image insert still fails: the dimension preflight fetches the un-tokened workspace image URL, which 403s for an anonymous visitor
samples.evidence: `shareTokenImageUploader` (image-insert.ts:40-49) deliberately returns the URL WITHOUT the share token (`/api/v1/workspaces//images/`, absolutised by `resolveImageUrl`). `insertImageFromFile` then immediately does `const { width, height } = await loadImageDimensions(url)` (line 101), which sets that URL as `img.src` on a bare `new Image()` — a plain GET with no `?token=` and no session cookie. That URL is served by `ApiV1ImageReadController.assertCanRead`, which for `user === undefined && !token` falls through to `throw new ForbiddenException('Not allowed to read this image')` (packages/backend/src/api/v1/image-read.controller.ts:128-133). So for the exact user this feature exists for (anonymous editor-share visitor) the preflight `img.onerror` fires, `loadImageDimensions` rejects, and the `catch` in `insertImageFromFile` shows `Image upload failed: Failed to load image: …` and NEVER calls `editor.insertImage`. Net effect: the bytes are uploaded (orphaned in S3, no CRDT reference) and the image is never inserted — acceptance criterion 1 of docs/tasks/active/20260907-share-link-image-upload-todo.md. The render-time `setImageUrlResolver`/`appendShareTokenToImageUrl` seam does not help here: it is only applied inside `packages/docs/src/view/image-cache.ts:getOrLoadImage`, not to this frontend preflight ``. Contrast the sheets/slides path, which measures dimensions from a local `URL.createObjectURL(file)` blob and therefore never re-fetches the gated URL (packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/image-upload.ts:76-96).

samples.summary: failureText loses the message for Nest validation-style errors whose `message` is an array, putting raw JSON in the toast it exists to prevent
samples.evidence: `failureText` only unwraps `typeof parsed.message === 'string'`. Nest's ValidationPipe / some filters emit `{"message":["..."],"statusCode":400}`; that hits the `typeof` check, falls through, and returns the whole JSON body — exactly the `{"message":...,"statusCode":...}` string the helper's own comment says must not reach the user. Contained (cosmetic message), but it is a real gap in the new branch.

samples.summary: `uploadImageRef.current` is mutated during render, so an abandoned/concurrent render can leave the ref pointing at an uploader from a render that was never committed
samples.evidence: `const uploadImageRef = useRef(uploadImage); uploadImageRef.current = uploadImage;` runs in the render body rather than in an effect. React explicitly disallows ref writes during render; with concurrent rendering (or a StrictMode double-render) the last render to execute — including one that is discarded — wins, and `onImageFileDrop` (docs-view.tsx:486-488) reads that value later. In practice the value is currently stable per token, so impact is contained, but the invariant the ref is supposed to hold ("the uploader of the committed tree") is not guaranteed. The rest of this file installs values via effects.

samples.summary: `uploadImage` is passed to DocsView even on a viewer-role link, so a drag/paste there attempts a doomed upload instead of being refused client-side
samples.evidence: `uploadImage` is built from `token` alone (lines 331-334) with no `readOnly` gate, and is handed to `DocsView` unconditionally at line 367 (the toolbar is gated on `!readOnly`, the view is not). If the read-only editor still surfaces `onImageFileDrop`, a viewer's dropped file is uploaded to `POST /api/v1/shared/images`, buffered server-side up to the Multer limit, and only then refused with 403 "This share link is read-only" — wasted round trip plus a confusing toast on a surface that has no insert affordance. Low confidence because the read-only editor may suppress the drop callback entirely.

samples.summary: assertCanWrite does not check that the token's document still exists in a usable (non-trashed) state, so a link to a trashed/deleted document can still write bytes into the workspace
samples.evidence: `assertCanWrite` only requires `link.role === 'editor'` and a truthy `link.document?.workspaceId`. `ShareLinkService.findByToken` (share-link.service.ts:102-117) checks only existence and `expiresAt`; it does not consult any trashed/deleted flag on the included `document`. So an editor token whose document has been trashed still authorizes an unauthenticated write into that workspace's key prefix. This mirrors the read route's behaviour, so it may be intentional; flagged as a possible invariant gap rather than a certain bug.
searchedFor: grep for deletedAt/trashed in share-link service context

samples.summary: Cache entries keyed by the tokened URL are never evicted when the resolver is cleared, so images re-fetch on every shared re-mount and the tokened keys are retained for the tab's life
samples.evidence: `getOrLoadImage` keys `imageCache`/`pendingImageCallbacks` by `urlResolver(logicalSrc)`. `setImageUrlResolver(null)` on unmount restores identity, so every previously cached entry becomes unreachable but is retained forever in the module-level `Map`; a re-mount with a different token also re-downloads everything. Contained (memory + redundant requests), but the cache no longer has a bounded key space per document.

verdict.reason: Verified end-to-end. shareTokenImageUploader (image-insert.ts:40-49) returns resolveImageUrl of the backend's token-less path (image-share-upload.controller.ts:112-115, comment "Deliberately without the token"); resolveImageUrl (export-utils.ts:12-18) only prepends the API base. insertImageFromFile awaits loadImageDimensions(url) at image-insert.ts:101, which sets that URL on a bare new Image() with no ?token= and intentionally no crossOrigin (lines 70-81); an anonymous visitor also has no session cookie. ApiV1ImageReadController.assertCanRead falls through all three branches for undefined user + no token and throws ForbiddenException (image-read.controller.ts:97-133), so img.onerror fires, the promise rejects, and the catch at image-insert.ts:109-116 toasts and never calls editor.insertImage — bytes uploaded, no CRDT reference. The render-time seam does not cover this: urlResolver is applied only inside getOrLoadImage (packages/docs/src/view/image-cache.ts:33-57), installed at shared-document.tsx:907, not to this preflight img. The path is the feature's primary one: shared-document.tsx:331-334 builds the uploader and passes it to DocsFormattingToolbar (line 360) and DocsView (line 367), which call insertImageFromFile (docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:279,898; docs-view.tsx:487). No guard appends the token before the preflight, and unlike the sheets path (spreadsheet/image-upload.ts:41) dimensions are not measured from the local file. Correctness lens: breaks a core flow for the exact user the feature exists for.
